title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-20
source: This is a restored version of shind: 97364; MR > R (Buddy Miller) HEAVILY EDITED > R @ 71/2ips (Will Boswell) > CD; Transfer info: reel > AKAI GX625 > Apogee Mini Me (24/96) > Apogee Mini Dac (monitoring) > Wavelab 5.0 (dithered to 16/44) > CD > EAC > Wav > Flac16Restoration completed with Diamond Cut Forensics 10.2.

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience capture with minor flaws showcases a stellar acoustic segment and a notably improved Caution transition.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its exceptional acoustic set featuring Phil on bass, David Grisman’s mandolin and David Nelson’s second mando, and an especially tight Caution that benefits from a cleaner opening and proper transition. Recording-wise the source (a stealth‑rig under‑stage tap) sounds generally good but exhibits occasional warble, reduced Pigpen harp/vocals and a slight organ boost, leading to mixed opinions about fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (two 5‑star reviews) offset by mixed comments on recording quality; overall rating leans high but not perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Minor audio imperfections, occasional warbled middle section, reduced Pigpen harp/vocal mic and boosted organ levels; source likely a stealth rig under the stage.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic segment with guest mandolin adds depth; Caution benefits from improved opening and seamless transition, creating a smooth flow despite recording quirks.

band_member_comments.Phil: Positive note on Phil playing bass during the acoustic numbers.
